Rule.name: Emergency Identity - Audit
Rule.Description:
Writes one AuditEvent for every Emergency Identity Disable / Enable request, including refused ones, and logs the same line to the server log.
Action : EmergencyIdentityDisable, EmergencyIdentityEnable or EmergencyIdentityDenied Source : requestor (launcher) Target : target identity Created : date and time string1 : workflow execution result (SUCCESS, PARTIAL, FAILED, NOTHING_TO_DO, DENIED) string2 : justification entered on the form string3 : Emergency Disable value before -> after string4 : per-account summary (shortened); full list in attribute "accounts"
Find the events in Advanced Analytics > Audit Search (action, source or target), or with the console: list AuditEvent / get AuditEvent <id>
